note: Rustic state forest campground on the banks of the Boardman River (a Blue Ribbon trout stream and designated Natural River), 12 miles southwest of Williamsburg via Williamsburg, Supply and Brown Bridge roads, Grand Traverse County; a stop on the Shore-to-Shore Trail. Shaded sites, a fishing platform on the river and paddle-in access for canoe campers. ORVs and snowmobiles may ride between the campground and nearby trails (Grand Traverse Motorcycle Trail 1 mile south). The adjacent Schecks Place Trail Camp is a separate 200-person equestrian group camp, not this entry. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only (now registered online/by phone from 8 a.m. on arrival day), 30 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max (inherited, now stated). 'Tent and small-to-medium trailer use' allows more than the boilerplate, not a restriction. Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic'; the page mentions horses only for the Shore-to-Shore Trail, and its sites are not described as open to horses. ORV/snowmobile riding to nearby trails allowed, not an ORV trail camp. Pin is exactly OSM's 'Scheck's Place State Forest Campground' polygon; the Trail Camp's DNR point (44.654486, -85.450250) is ~490 m ENE. Phone 231-922-5270 matches.
